```{r check_dds}

# R
library(tibble)

# Gene aus beiden dds
genes1 <- rownames(dds_kelly)
genes2 <- rownames(dds_SKNAS)

# Schnittmenge / Unterschiede
common_genes <- intersect(genes1, genes2)
only_in_kelly <- setdiff(genes1, genes2)
only_in_SKNAS <- setdiff(genes2, genes1)

# Beide dds auf gemeinsame Reihenfolge bringen (falls nötig)
dds_kelly_shared <- dds_kelly[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
dds_SKNAS_shared <- dds_SKNAS[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Kurze Zusammenfassung
summary_df <- tibble(
  dataset = c("dds_kelly", "dds_SKNAS", "common"),
  n_genes = c(length(genes1), length(genes2), length(common_genes))
)

# Ergebnis zurückgeben
res_check <- list(
  common_genes = common_genes,
  only_in_kelly = only_in_kelly,
  only_in_SKNAS = only_in_SKNAS,
  dds_kelly_shared = dds_kelly_shared,
  dds_SKNAS_shared = dds_SKNAS_shared,
  summary = summary_df
)

res_check %>% head()

colData(dds_SKNAS)
colData(dds_kelly)

```


```{r combine_dds}

# r
library(stringr)
library(DESeq2)

# 1) Standardisiere SKNAS condition -> "Nx"/"Hx"
colData(dds_SKNAS)$cond <- case_when(
  str_detect(tolower(as.character(colData(dds_SKNAS)$Condition)), "^\\s*norm") ~ "Nx",
  str_detect(tolower(as.character(colData(dds_SKNAS)$Condition)), "^\\s*hyp")  ~ "Hx",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

# 2) Kelly: ensure condition column and filter WT samples with Nx/Hx
colData(dds_kelly)$cond <- as.character(colData(dds_kelly)$condition)
keep_kelly <- which(colData(dds_kelly)$genotype == "WT" & colData(dds_kelly)$cond %in% c("Nx","Hx"))
dds_kelly_wt <- dds_kelly[, keep_kelly]

# 3) common genes and subset
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(dds_kelly_wt), rownames(dds_SKNAS))
dds_kelly_sub <- dds_kelly_wt[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
dds_SKNAS_sub <- dds_SKNAS[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# 4) make unique column names and combine
colnames(dds_kelly_sub) <- paste0("kelly_", colnames(dds_kelly_sub))
colnames(dds_SKNAS_sub) <- paste0("sknas_", colnames(dds_SKNAS_sub))


# Counts extrahieren (als Matrix)
cnt1 <- as.matrix(assay(dds_kelly_sub))
cnt2 <- as.matrix(assay(dds_SKNAS_sub))

# kombiniere Counts (Spaltennamen müssen stimmen)
counts_comb <- cbind(cnt1, cnt2)

# Metadaten für jede Probe in data.frame und RowNames setzen
cd1 <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_kelly_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cd2 <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_SKNAS_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(cd1) <- colnames(cnt1)
rownames(cd2) <- colnames(cnt2)

# vereinheitlichte colData nur mit experiment + condition
coldata_comb <- data.frame(
  experiment = factor(c(rep("kelly", ncol(cnt1)), rep("sknas", ncol(cnt2)))),
  condition  = factor(c(as.character(cd1$cond), as.character(cd2$cond))),
  row.names  = colnames(counts_comb)
)

# neues DESeqDataSet bauen
dds_comb <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_comb,
  colData   = coldata_comb,
  design    = ~ experiment + condition
)

# (Optional) DESeq laufen lassen:
# dds_comb <- DESeq(dds_comb)

dds_comb

```


```{r SKNAS_KElly}

# line für SKNAS/SHSY5Y bestimmen
cd2 <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_SKNAS_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
line2 <- ifelse(
  grepl("sk-n-as", tolower(cd2$Celltype)),
  "SKNAS",
  "SHSY5Y"
)

coldata_comb$line <- factor(
  c(rep("Kelly", ncol(cnt1)), line2),
  levels = c("Kelly", "SKNAS", "SHSY5Y")
)
coldata_comb$condition <- relevel(factor(coldata_comb$condition), "Nx")

dds_comb <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_comb,
  colData   = coldata_comb,
  design    = ~ line + condition + line:condition
)

dds_comb <- DESeq(dds_comb)
resultsNames(dds_comb)

# einzelne Hx:Nx-Vergleiche
res_kelly  <- results(dds_comb, name = "condition_Hx_vs_Nx")
res_sknas  <- results(dds_comb, list = c("condition_Hx_vs_Nx", "lineSKNAS.conditionHx"))
res_shsy5y <- results(dds_comb, list = c("condition_Hx_vs_Nx", "lineSHSY5Y.conditionHx"))

# basal Kelly Nx vs SKNAS Nx / SHSY5Y Nx
res_sknas_nx  <- results(dds_comb, name = "lineSKNAS")
res_shsy5y_nx <- results(dds_comb, name = "lineSHSY5Y")

# Interaktion: Hypoxie-Antwort anders als bei Kelly
res_int_sknas  <- results(dds_comb, name = "lineSKNAS.conditionHx")
res_int_shsy5y <- results(dds_comb, name = "lineSHSY5Y.conditionHx")

# Gene, wo Kelly Nx anders ist als beide
sig_sk_nx <- rownames(res_sknas_nx)[which(res_sknas_nx$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_sknas_nx$log2FoldChange) > 1)]
sig_sh_nx <- rownames(res_shsy5y_nx)[which(res_shsy5y_nx$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_shsy5y_nx$log2FoldChange) > 1)]
sig_kelly_diff_both <- intersect(sig_sk_nx, sig_sh_nx)
sig_kelly_diff_one  <- union(sig_sk_nx, sig_sh_nx)

# Gene, wo die Hypoxie-Antwort bei Kelly anders ist als bei beiden
sig_int_sk <- rownames(res_int_sknas)[which(res_int_sknas$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_int_sknas$log2FoldChange) > 1)]
sig_int_sh <- rownames(res_int_shsy5y)[which(res_int_shsy5y$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_int_shsy5y$log2FoldChange) > 1)]
sig_interact_both <- intersect(sig_int_sk, sig_int_sh)
sig_interact_one  <- union(sig_int_sk, sig_int_sh)

result_list <- list(
  res_kelly = res_kelly,
  res_sknas = res_sknas,
  res_shsy5y = res_shsy5y,
  res_sknas_nx = res_sknas_nx,
  res_shsy5y_nx = res_shsy5y_nx,
  res_int_sknas = res_int_sknas,
  res_int_shsy5y = res_int_shsy5y,
  sig_kelly_diff_both = sig_kelly_diff_both,
  sig_kelly_diff_one = sig_kelly_diff_one,
  sig_interact_both = sig_interact_both,
  sig_interact_one = sig_interact_one
)

result_list
```
